subject: Educational Psychology
stem: A multiple-choice test, where every examiner would mark the same answer sheet identically, is described as having high:
explanation: Objectivity/scorer reliability means the test yields the same score regardless of who marks it — a key strength of well-designed MCQ tests over essay-type tests scored subjectively.

section: Educational Psychology · Ch13 — Assessment — Deep Practice 3
subject: Educational Psychology
stem: Administering the same test to the same group of students twice, a few weeks apart, and comparing the two sets of scores measures a test's:
explanation: Test-retest reliability checks whether a test produces consistent scores across repeated administrations over time — a specific method for assessing reliability, distinct from validity checks.

subject: Educational Psychology
stem: A Class 8 science test that covers questions from every unit taught during the term, in proportion to the time spent on each, is demonstrating good:
explanation: Content validity concerns whether a test adequately samples the full domain of content it claims to measure — proportional coverage of taught units is a hallmark of good content validity.
